questions.question: Jesus said that in his Father's house are many dwelling places, and that he was going there to do what?
options: Build a new and greater temple
Prepare a place for his disciples
questions.answer: Prepare a place for his disciples

questions.question: Which disciple asked Jesus, 'Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us'?
Jesus promised to send the Holy Spirit as a Counselor to be with the disciples forever.
Jesus said, 'I am the way, the _____, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.'
_____ I leave with you. My peace I give to you. Not as the world gives, I give to you.
